dataset_example.question:
You are playing expert Minesweeper via text.
Board is hidden. Coordinates are 1-indexed (row,col). One action per turn. No chord.
Actions:
  <clear>r,c</clear>  — open a cell
  <flag>r,c</flag>    — toggle a flag on a hidden cell
Rules:
- First click is guaranteed to reveal a zero, which flood-expands.
- Clearing a mine ends the game (loss). Win by revealing all non-mine cells.
- You cannot clear
